formulas.total_operating_costs: purchased_commodities + production_and_operating_expenses + sga + exploration + depreciation + impairments + taxes_other_than_income + accretion + other_operating_expenses_net

sales_revenue_yoy.description: Sales and other operating revenues YoY growth rate vs Q-4

other_operating_income_yoy.description: Other operating income (equity earnings, gain/loss on dispositions, other) YoY growth rate vs Q-4

purchased_commodities_margin_delta_bps.description: Purchased commodities as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

production_costs_margin_delta_bps.description: Production and operating expenses as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

sga_margin_delta_bps.description: Selling, general and administrative expenses as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

depreciation_margin_delta_bps.description: Depreciation, depletion and amortization as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

exploration_yoy.description: exploration YoY growth rate vs Q-4

impairments_abs.description: impairments absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

taxes_other_than_income_yoy.description: taxes_other_than_income YoY growth rate vs Q-4

accretion_abs.description: accretion absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

interest_debt_yoy.description: interest_debt YoY growth rate vs Q-4

other_operating_expenses_net_abs.description: other_operating_expenses_net absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).
